fixtures.description: Don't assert unverified negative — SwiftShip order showing BOOKED may have been picked up (KI-211 webhook delay)

input.query: My pickup didn't happen, did something go wrong?

expected.caveat: KI-211: SwiftShip pickup confirmation webhooks can arrive up to 20 minutes late. The parcel may have been physically collected while ParcelPilot still shows BOOKED.
expected.recommendation: Verify the carrier status directly or wait through the known delay window before concluding the pickup did not occur.
expected.must_not_assert: Pickup definitively failed based on BOOKED status alone
expected.evidence_status_reasoning: One authoritative source (KI-211) with unresolved known issue caveat

fact_provenance.fact: KI-211: SwiftShip webhooks can be up to 20 minutes late; parcel may be collected while showing BOOKED
BOOKED status for a SwiftShip order does not reliably mean pickup has not occurred

wrong_answers_to_catch: Confidently stating pickup failed based solely on BOOKED status
Not surfacing KI-211 for a SwiftShip order
